## Summary

Describe the user-visible or release-engineering outcome and the platform scope.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Physical devices/adapters tested are listed, or the lack of physical testing is explicit.
- [ ] No generated binary, dependency directory, signing key, identity, message, or location data is committed.
- [ ] Upstream behavior and source are attributed where applicable.
- [ ] Capability and security documentation is updated without overstating parity.
- [ ] Android GPL notice and corresponding-source requirements remain intact.

## Evidence and limits

Provide sanitized logs, screenshots, checksums, or reproduction steps, then list anything not verified.
